insights.one_liner: Boston Scientific is a US medical device giant with around 59,000 staff and a recognised-sponsor Dutch entity, offering a data internship in Kerkrade.

culture.text: It makes devices and therapies for heart, lung, digestive, cancer, neurological and urological conditions.
It is a huge company: 55,111 people on LinkedIn, mostly in operations, sales, engineering and quality.
Staff often studied business, mechanical or biomedical engineering, at schools like the University of Minnesota, University of Galway and University of Limerick.

open.text: Boston Scientific International B.V. and Boston Scientific Group plc are IND recognised visa sponsors.
Its one current job here, a data internship in Kerkrade, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Founded in 1979, headquartered in Marlborough, US, with about 59,000 employees.
It said it is unlikely to meet its 2026 sales and profit forecast after a cyberattack.

worth_knowing.text: A cyberattack disrupted operations; the company said it had fully restored them a few days later.
It recalled a spinal cord implant after more than 1,000 serious injuries were reported.
